scenes.name: THE QUESTION
lines: A diagonal quantum operation changes phases without changing the input bits. Our target turns only the all-zero and all-one amplitudes by a quarter circle.
对角量子操作只改变相位，不改变输入比特。这里的目标只让全零和全一振幅转过四分之一圈。
Complementing every bit exchanges those two marked inputs, so the target has reflection symmetry. How many controlled bit flips are unavoidable?
全部比特取反会交换两个标记输入，因此目标具有反射对称性。究竟多少次受控翻转不可避免？

scenes.name: COMPUTE AND RESTORE
lines: For two bits, one CNOT computes their exclusive-or on the second wire. Equal bits give zero; different bits give one.
两比特时，一个 CNOT 在第二条线上算出异或。相同得零，不同得一。
Rotate that wire, then repeat the CNOT to restore the input. Two gates implement the target up to one common phase. Restoration matters.
旋转这条线，再重复 CNOT 恢复输入。两门就能实现目标到一个整体相位。恢复步骤很重要。

scenes.name: DETECT A LABEL
lines: On more wires, a label records which original bits are combined by exclusive-or. A rotation uses the current label of its wire.
更多线上，标签记录哪些原始比特被异或起来。每次旋转使用该线当前的标签。
Fix a nonzero label. Multiply phases for parity zero, and divide by the product for parity one. Global phase cancels.
固定一个非零标签。将零奇偶组的相位相乘，除以一奇偶组的乘积。整体相位会抵消。
A different nonzero rotation label cancels too: pair inputs with equal rotation factors and opposite positions in the ratio.
其他非零旋转标签也会抵消：将旋转因子相同、但处于比值两侧的输入配对。

scenes.name: FORCE EVEN LABELS
lines: An even label selects an even number of input bits. Both marked inputs then have parity zero, so their contribution is i times i: minus one.
偶标签选中偶数个输入位。两个标记输入的奇偶都为零，贡献为 i 乘 i，等于负一。
Without a rotation on this label, cancellation would give one instead. Every nonzero even label must therefore appear on a rotated wire.
若从未在该标签上旋转，消去却会给出一。因此每个非零偶标签都必须出现在旋转线上。

scenes.name: CREATE THE LABELS
lines: There are two raised to the power m minus one even labels, including zero. Every nonzero even label needs a first CNOT output.
偶标签共有二的 m 减一次方个，包括零。每个非零偶标签首次出现，都需要一次 CNOT 输出。
Combining two odd labels creates an even label: call this a birth. Every even label ever produced is an exclusive-or combination of birth outputs.
两个奇标签相加得到偶标签，称为出生。每个曾产生的偶标签都是出生输出的异或组合。
The even labels have m minus one independent directions. At least m minus one births are needed to span them.
偶标签有 m 减一个独立方向。因此至少需要 m 减一次出生才能张成它们。

scenes.name: PAY FOR THE RETURN
lines: Count the even labels currently on wires. Each birth adds one. Only an even target with an odd control removes one. Call that a return.
数一数当前线上的偶标签。出生加一；只有偶目标加奇控制才减一，称为返回。
The count starts and ends at zero, so returns equal births. Returns have odd outputs, additional to the even outputs already counted.
这个数从零开始并回到零，所以返回与出生一样多。返回输出奇标签，是已计偶输出之外的额外门。
On four wires, seven required even labels plus at least three returns give at least ten CNOT gates.
四条线上，七个必需偶标签加至少三次返回，总计至少十个 CNOT 门。

scenes.name: THE EXACT WORST CASE
lines: For m equal to two n, with n at least one, the lower bound is two to the m minus one, plus m minus two.
当 m 等于二 n 且 n 至少为一，下界为二的 m 减一次方，加 m 减二。
The public Lean theorem proves that a hard symmetric target exists. Its proof uses this explicit target.
公开 Lean 定理证明存在困难的对称目标，其证明使用了这里的明确目标。

Huang, Kosugi, Nishi and Matsushita supply the matching universal construction. Together these results give the exact worst-case gate count. Optimal depth and the narrower radial-potential family remain separate questions.
Huang、Kosugi、Nishi 与 Matsushita 已给出匹配的普适构造。两者确定精确最坏门数；最优深度与更窄的径向势族仍是另外的问题。
